item.title: Prep Scores From Friday
item.description: The Sturgeon Bay-Sevastopol girls wrestling team finished eleventh out of 28 teams at Wrightstown. Tiani Lemieux was first at 165 pounds. She pinned Kewaunee’s Arianna Niemojuski in the title match. In fact, Lemieux won all three of her matches by pinfall. Anna Dahlke finished third at 185 and Kimberly Robertoy was sixth at 152. item.title: Kewaunee Tames Tigers
item.description: The Kewaunee girls baksetball team beat Wrightstown Monday at the Kress Center, 67-37. The Storm (6-2) outscored the Tigers 28-4 over the final 10:25 of the first half. Jade Kroll scored a game-high 25 points as Kewaunee won their fifth straight. Summer Walechka and Gabby Stangel each scored 13 points in the win and Braelyn Chevalier added 10 points. item.description: The Sturgeon Bay girls basketball team won at Gibraltar Monday, 43-34. item.title: Algoma Wins Sixth Straight
item.description: The Algoma boys won at home Tuesday as they beat Sturgeon Bay, 59-51. A fast break layup gave the Wolves (4-1 Packerland / 8-1 overall) a one point lead at halftime. That advantage grew to ten before the Clippers were able to cut the deficit down to two. Algoma was able to respond and pick up their sixth straight win. item.description: The Algoma girls basketball team beat Gibraltar Friday night, 63-20. The Wolves (6-0 Packerland / 7-5 overall) led 38-14 at halftime and then opened the second half on an 18-2 run.
